name: open-web
description: Open-web: in-browser IDE + file/diff preview — load GitHub repos, edit, run, and review diffs. No server required.

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p wasm-rust --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir apps/web/public/wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/open_web_wasm.wasm
